[1m📊 Cache & Memory: 512-bit, 6 threads[0m
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tier        Read GiB/s  Write GiB/s  Copy GiB/s  Read MiB/s  Write MiB/s  Copy MiB/s  Latency, 6 threads  Latency, clean  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
L1              1540.5        852.1      1671.5     1577506       872545     1711623              0.8 ns               -  
L2               850.7        824.4       831.4      871126       844195      851371              2.7 ns               -  
L3*              634.9        614.3       620.4      650150       629007      635318              4.6 ns          8.7 ns  
Memory            59.5         59.5        73.5       60926        60894       75307             63.5 ns         67.0 ns  
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bandwidth: every thread at once; copy counts the bytes read and the bytes written. Memory's write and copy are NT stores.
Latency: the read chase's P50, every thread chasing at once.
* The L3 row's latency: each of the 6 threads chases 1.27 MiB, 1.28x its 1014 KiB L2, so the L2 serves an estimated 78% of the chase.
Latency, clean: on the L3, 1 thread chases 7.50 MiB, an estimated 87% of it in the L3, short of the 88% target even with one; in Memory, 1 thread chases 1.00 GiB; the other threads sit out.
Memory's write latency: 62.0 ns a 64 B line, NT-stored then SFENCE, a line at a time, one thread over 1.00 GiB: until the stores are visible, not until they reach DRAM.

================================================================================
[1m📊 Memory under load: one core's read latency while 7 other cores load memory[0m
------------------------------------------------------------
Load             Under NT writes  Under reads   Turnaround  
------------------------------------------------------------
idle                    102.8 ns                            
25% 4029 MiB/s          113.0 ns     111.6 ns      +1.4 ns  
50% 8059 MiB/s          127.0 ns     121.2 ns      +6.0 ns  
75% 12088 MiB/s      not matched  not matched  not matched  
------------------------------------------------------------
Load: shares of the other cores' lower flat-out MiB/s, 16117 MiB/s.
Turnaround: what a read pays when the other cores write rather than read at the same MiB/s, from paired windows, so it can differ from the columns' difference; negative when reads cost a read more.
